title: DOC: Improving Long Story Coherence With Detailed Outline Control
scope: ACL 2023 paper; hierarchical planning and passage control for several-thousand-word stories; human evaluation.
limitation: Historical GPT-3-era systems; does not establish effectiveness at novel length or with current models.

title: StoryWriter: A Multi-Agent Framework for Long Story Generation
scope: Preprint v1; event outlines, chapter planning, compressed history; human and model evaluation.
limitation: Average evaluated output is 8,081 words; baseline lengths differ substantially; not a full-novel validation.

title: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
scope: Science Advances randomized experiment; GPT-4 idea assistance for human-written eight-sentence stories.
limitation: Microfiction, fixed idea prompts, no iterative collaboration; not evidence about entirely AI-authored novels.

title: Help Me Write a Story: Evaluating LLMs' Ability to Generate Writing Feedback
scope: ACL 2025 paper, read through arXiv v1; 1,300-story feedback benchmark with synthetic problems.
limitation: Short English stories and older model set; measures single-turn feedback, not iterative revision outcomes.

title: Readers Prefer Outputs of AI Trained on Copyrighted Books over Expert Human Writers
scope: Preprint v4; preregistered blinded comparison of up-to-450-word author-emulation excerpts across reader groups.
limitation: Short excerpts, older models, and author-specific fine-tuning; neither a novel-quality test nor a contest-jury proxy.

title: CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories
scope: Preprint v1; feature-guided story revision; cross-editor comparisons and human evaluation.
limitation: Human study has 20 eligible groups; perceived human-likeness and model-derived features do not establish literary merit or novel coherence.

title: FactTrack: Time-Aware World State Tracking in Story Outlines
scope: 90 generated outlines; 39 events each; mean 2490.5 words, SD 594.6.
human_evaluation: Human annotation attempt abandoned as too noisy/costly; final contradiction evaluation uses GPT-4 scores.
limitation: Only 2000-3000-word outlines evaluated. Incomplete contradiction labels; proxy scoring and model dependence limit claims.

title: Finding Flawed Fictions: Evaluating Complex Reasoning in Language Models via Plot Hole Detection
scope: 414 short stories averaging 731.81 words; 200 longer stories averaging 2703.09, maximum 3999 words.
human_evaluation: Nine English undergraduates assessed 50 short examples, three judgments each; separate benchmark filtering.
limitation: Longer stories sharply reduce detection. Extra reasoning usually gives little benefit. Sentence-pair entailment produces false positives; bluffing and genre conventions can be misread.

title: Staying In Character: Perspective-Bounded Memory for Book-Based Role-Playing Agents
scope: 4386 knowledge-boundary questions across eight novels; narrative task uses 226 scripts. No full-generated-novel length claim adopted.
human_evaluation: Humans verify benchmark questions; narrative win rates are model judgments, not new human reader ratings.
limitation: Unrestricted retrieval recalls visible facts but often answers inaccessible facts. Removing episodic memory improves recall while harming refusal: accuracy components trade off.

title: Narrative Knowledge Weaver: Narrative-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Long-Form Text Understanding
scope: QA: STAGE 151 screenplays, average 27546 English whitespace words or Chinese characters; QuALITY 4115 words; FairytaleQA 2165 words on average.
human_evaluation: Uses existing QA data; reported evaluator agreement is repeated LLM agreement, not new human reader validation.
limitation: Lightweight retrieval remains competitive on passage-centered QA. Extraction errors propagate; extra construction/query cost and path variance persist.

title: Scaling Long-Form Story Generation via Narrative State Tracking
scope: 10K, 20K, 50K and 100K word targets; 100 prompts, with 50 used at 100K.
human_evaluation: No independent human reader comparison; reported main scores are LLM judgments. Authors audit selected alerts.
limitation: Luna at 10K is statistically at parity with rolling summary. Incorrect state can entrench errors. Injected control pairs have 25% target-type false alerts; explicit-injection recall does not establish subtle-error recall.

title: Shared Worlds, Private Minds: Structured Memory for Long-Form Writing as World Creation
scope: ConStory-Bench 200 tasks; TMAS 168 checkpoints; LSGC five starters, 14 chapters, 42000-word target and 40000-word completion minimum; individual lengths not independently verified.
human_evaluation: Four assessors, two per complete story; 36 ConStory stories and 15 LSGC stories in a separate human sample.
limitation: Only five adjudicated consistency positives. Full Context leads two human LSGC dimensions. Judge-human overall rho=.55; final-piece automatic score reads a summary. Hypotheses hurt factual QA; construction averages about 200 calls/story.

title: The Challenge and Reward of Fair Play in Narrative: A Computational Approach
scope: 25-paragraph generated detective stories; 54 generated and 11 real stories receive human annotation.
human_evaluation: 20 participants predict culprits paragraph by paragraph and rate fairness, coherence, surprise and enjoyment.
limitation: Small reader pool; main metric is an upper bound. Known-suspect and single-distractor assumptions limit genre coverage. Model generation habits can reveal answers without useful clues.

title: Long Story Generation via Knowledge Graph and Literary Theory
scope: Main outputs instructed to exceed 10000 words; 5000-word ablations; revision-round study uses 700-word stories.
human_evaluation: 20 native-English Prolific readers, two per pair; reported task allocation is uneven.
limitation: DOC comparator omits its controller. Three revision rounds score below one/two in the short-story Auto-J study; no proof of a universal best revision count.
